label: The formulation
subgoals: Introduce arrival-time variables and a margin
Subtract the margin from every setup and hold bound
Sum around a cycle to bound the margin

label: A two-flop loop with hold
subgoals: Bound the skew from above by setup one way and hold the other
Bound it from below the same way
Add the bounds to get the optimal margin and skew

label: From schedule to tree
subgoals: Turn the optimal arrivals into latency targets
Build the tree to meet the targets
Bound and iterate the schedule as delays change
